description: This file contains functions and data related to generating OTA (Over-The-Air) update packages for Android devices. It manages user image partitions, retrieves images, and computes differences for full and incremental updates.

methods.name: GetUserImages
methods.description: Retrieves user images for specified partitions if their image files exist.

methods.name: FullOTA_GetBlockDifferences
methods.description: Computes block differences for a full OTA update based on current images.

methods.name: IncrementalOTA_GetBlockDifferences
methods.description: Computes block differences for an incremental OTA update, considering source and target images.
